name: Additional Parameters 16
definition: Specifies additional parameters to the message or transaction.

PreviousPartialConfirmationIdentificatio.name: Previous Partial Confirmation Identification
PreviousPartialConfirmationIdentificatio.definition: Identification of the confirmation previously sent to confirm the partial settlement of a transaction.

AccountOwnerTransactionIdentification.name: Account Owner Transaction Identification
AccountOwnerTransactionIdentification.definition: Unambiguous identification of the transaction as known by the account owner (or the instructing party managing the account).

AccountServicerTransactionIdentification.name: Account Servicer Transaction Identification
AccountServicerTransactionIdentification.definition: Unambiguous identification of the transaction as known by the account servicer.

PoolIdentification.name: Pool Identification
PoolIdentification.definition: Collective reference identifying a set of messages.

CorporateActionEventIdentification.name: Corporate Action Event Identification
CorporateActionEventIdentification.definition: Identification assigned by the account servicer to unambiguously identify a corporate action event.

MarketInfrastructureTransactionIdentific.name: Market Infrastructure Transaction Identification
MarketInfrastructureTransactionIdentific.definition: Identification of a transaction assigned by a market infrastructure other than a central securities depository, for example, Target2-Securities.

ProcessorTransactionIdentification.name: Processor Transaction Identification
ProcessorTransactionIdentification.definition: Identification of the transaction as assigned by the processor.
